Texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework.
Texts.PublicHome:heroDesc: Design, manage and orchestrate complex workflows in one unified platform. Build smarter processes and move faster with FlowForge Cloud.
Texts.PublicHome:heroNote: Built for modern teams and scalable automation.
Texts.PublicHome:capabilitiesDesc: One workspace for designing, running and monitoring workflows.
Texts.PublicHome:feature1Desc: Design workflow definitions using an intuitive visual editor.
Texts.PublicHome:feature2Desc: Orchestrate processes with state management, retries and scheduling.
Texts.PublicHome:feature3Desc: Track executions, diagnose failures and understand workflow activity.
